hero.h1: Bathroom Remodeling and Basement Finishing With Mike
hero.subheadline: Happy Home Remodeling rebuilds bathrooms, finishes basements and handles the permits, plumber, electrician and inspections, with one person keeping you in the loop.

image.alt: Bathroom remodeling by Happy Home Remodeling: freestanding tub with floor-mounted filler beside a walk-in tile shower with a black-framed glass door

paragraphs: Happy Home Remodeling takes on bathroom remodeling that goes beyond a new vanity. MaryChris had walls moved and heated tile flooring installed in a full bathroom remodel, then had a second bathroom updated, an exterior door replaced and a list of small repairs done.

What customers notice is how Mike runs the job. Costs, permits, the plumber and electrician, and inspections are explained up front, and the work is finished within the timeline he gives you. Michael E. had a whole basement finished, with drywall, hard flooring, doors, a shower and paint, and says Mike was quick, detail-minded and always responsive. Communication is the topic reviewers mention most often.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels, including moving walls, heated tile floors, walk-in showers with glass doors, freestanding tubs, double vanities and lighted mirrors. Mike subcontracts the plumber and electrician, schedules permits and inspections, and finishes within the timeline he quotes.

about.h2: About Mike and Happy Home Remodeling
about.text: Happy Home Remodeling, LLC is run by Mike, and every review names him. Homeowners who are new to the area say they interviewed several contractors on price, trust, reliability and competence, and that Mike ticked all the boxes. He takes on bathrooms, basements, pantries, decks, doors and roof repairs, and coordinates the plumber, electrician, permits and inspections himself. Customers describe him as friendly, responsive and careful, and several have hired him again for a second or third project around the same house.

image.alt: Basement remodel in progress with cabinets on site and a reclaimed-look wood plank accent wall around an entry door

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: Call (720) 713-3443 and describe the project, the rooms involved and roughly when you would like the work done.

steps.title: Clear costs and schedule
steps.text: You get a clear picture of costs, the timeline, the permits needed and which licensed trades will be involved.

steps.title: Permits and trades
steps.text: Mike schedules the permits, brings in the plumber and electrician as subcontractors, and books the inspections.

steps.title: Build within the timeline
steps.text: The work is completed within the stated timeline, with Mike handling any unexpected glitch and keeping you updated.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: After the final inspection, Mike goes over the finished space with you and fixes anything you are not happy with.

items.name: MaryChris
items.text: We just completed a comprehensive bathroom remodel (which included moving walls, installation of heated tile flooring), second bathroom update, exterior door replacement and assorted minor repairs with Happy Home Remodeling. Being new to the area, we were fortunate to come across a contractor that has knowledge, expertise AND troubleshooting savvy. (No construction remodel is without an unexpected glitch). We did interview a few contractors, as much for pricing but just as important, to get a feel for level of trust, reliability, competence and confidence. Mike ticks all the boxes. All along, communication was clear, regarding costs, scheduling of necessary permits, sub- contracting (plumber/electrician) and  inspections. Installation was meticulously completed within  the stated timeline.

items.name: Michael E.
items.text: Mike did an awesome job completing our basement which involved installing drywall, hard flooring, doors, shower and painting. He completed the job quickly with attention to detail and was always friendly and responsive to our requests. Would highly recommend.

items.name: N.
items.text: Highly recommend Mike.  He has done several projects for me - pantry remodel, deck replacement and roof repair.  Everything he has done has met or exceeded my expectations.  He communicates well and has an eye for detail which makes working with him enjoyable.

service_area.text: Mike's Google profile does not list a street address or the towns he covers yet, and the phone number is a 720 number. The simplest check is a quick call to (720) 713-3443: tell him where the house is and what you want done, and he will let you know if he can take it on and roughly when he could start.

items.q: Do you handle permits and inspections?
items.a: Yes. A recent customer says Mike communicated clearly about scheduling the necessary permits and inspections, and handled subcontracting the plumber and electrician. You will know which permits your project needs and when inspections happen, without having to arrange them yourself.

Yes. Mike has finished basements including framing, drywall, hard flooring, doors, a shower and painting. One customer says the job was completed quickly with attention to detail, and that Mike was always friendly and responsive to requests during the project. Call to talk about your layout.

items.q: Will the job finish on time?
items.a: Mike gives you a timeline before work starts. One reviewer says her bathroom installation was meticulously completed within the stated timeline, even though, in her words, no construction remodel is without an unexpected glitch. She credits his knowledge, expertise and troubleshooting savvy for keeping the project on track.

items.q: Do you take on small jobs and repairs?
items.a: Yes. Alongside full bathroom and basement remodels, customers have hired Mike for a pantry remodel, an exterior door replacement, a deck replacement, a roof repair and assorted minor repairs. Several have hired him for more than one project. Ask about smaller jobs when you call.

Call (720) 713-3443 and describe the project, with your address and a few photos if you can. Mike will talk through what you want, the likely permits and trades, and the timeline. The Google listing shows hours as 12 AM to 12 PM every day, so call to confirm the best time.

final_cta.h2: Ready to Remodel Your Bathroom or Basement?
final_cta.text: Call Mike to talk through your bathroom remodeling, basement or repair project.
